text:
jamie: Starting change window for feature flag llm_router_v4. Plan: staggered ramp — 5% for 10m (smoke users), 25% for 10m, 60% for 10m, then full. Will keep fallback pinned to model-route:v3.9 for 2h. Tagging @oncall @sre. Release notes updated.

deploy-bot: Deploy requested by jamie at 2026-03-23T15:20:34Z. Actions:
 - ff set llm_router_v4 pct=5 cohort=smoke
 - deploy image redwood/infer:v4.2.3 -> pool-prod-b
Gates: p95_latency < 220ms, error_rate < 0.6%. Auto-rollback: error_rate > 1% sustained for 90s OR p95 > 400ms for 2m.

sven: Can we pin fallback on the routing layer only (not global) so internal traffic uses v4 for tracing? If so, pin command: ```ops pin-route --route llm_route --version v3.9 --scope fallback --ttl 2h```

jamie: Yep, pin scoped. Doing it now.

deploy-bot: Route llm_route pinned to v3.9 (scope=fallback ttl=2h) (1769201250).

marie: Observability: starting smoke evals. I'll watch rerank drift (target <1%) and token-per-request median. Posting dashboard link.

dave: If we see KV cache churn spike, consider reducing pct to 0 immediately. Quick rollback snippet for slack: ```/ff set llm_router_v4 0 "rollback - kv-churn"```

oncall: I'll take lead for the first 30m and handoff if all green.

deploy-bot: llm_router_v4 set to 5% (1769201265). Canary traffic routing active.

jamie: 6 minute check: small error blip +0.2%, p95 +8ms. staying at 5%.

marie: Smoke eval run #1: rerank drift 0.7%, median tokens/request unchanged. No traces of KV errors.

deploy-bot: Rolling to 25% (1769201300).

jamie: 25% looks stable at +4m. moving to 60% in 10m if no anomalies.

marie: Note: small uptick in downstream cache misses around host-a, investigating. Not triggering gates yet.

sven: Might be a warmup artifact for the new route. If it persists >5m, we should throttle to 10% and open an ops ticket.

dave: Agreed. Prepped rollback playbook and issued a short checklist in the changelog.

deploy-bot: llm_router_v4 set to 60% (1769201345).

jamie: After 3m at 60% we see p95 +15ms but under gate, error rate 0.18%. cache misses trending down. Proceeding to 100%.

marie: I'll add a brief regression alert to the nightly evals for cache-miss spike detection.

deploy-bot: llm_router_v4 set to 100% (1769201358). image redwood/infer:v4.2.3 deployed to pool-prod-b. No auto-rollback triggered.

jamie: Done. Release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/llm_router_v4-4.2.3 includes rollback commands, pinned fallback details, and post-deploy observability checklist. Closing window; leaving fallback pin for 2h. Thanks all. :rocket:

oncall: Acknowledged. I'll file the postmortem-lite doc if any late regressions show up and link this thread.

dave: Follow-up item: add explicit TTL awareness to deploybot so it warns when pin TTL overlaps maintenance windows.

jamie: Noted and added to backlog. Closing thread.
